unresolvedQuestions: Completion was due by the end of Q3 2026; no completion or handover item found (Dubai South newsroom 11 Nov, search 12 Nov 2026): overdue, unconfirmed.
Investment value not disclosed; basis of 16,661 m² not stated.

events.summary: Dubai Media Office (12 Aug 2025): MBRAH "has announced the launch of its new Sky Support Complex", 16,661 m², 14 units.
Dubai South (28 Jul 2026): MBRAH "has announced that construction of its Sky Support Complex is on track for completion by the end of Q3 2026".

projects.seedNote: Found while seeding from the owner's Nov 2026 briefing PDF, which listed it apart as unconfirmed. Every field follows the sources.
